jobs.prompt: Wide comic panel from inside a fifth-floor law office: dark wood desk, banker's lamp pool of light, rotary phone, ashtray, one unmarked manila dossier with a plain blood-red wax disc, venetian blinds, heavy rain on the glass, Palace of Culture needle-spire wet and distant. Empty brass plate. No paper writing.

First-person comic panel: two lawyer hands only, fountain pen, signet ring with an eagle, cracked plain blood-red wax disc, blank manila folders, stripe shadows from blinds, rainy Warsaw and Palace of Culture through the window. No face. No writing on paper.

Tight portrait of the same young male trainee: round thin wire glasses, messy dark hair, nervous glance, rumpled white shirt, ink on knuckles, one thin blood-red streak under the left eye, blinds at left. Same face. No papers, no books, no signs.

Portrait of the same middle-aged male partner: receding hair, heavy overcoat, vintage telephone handset, night rain, a blank blood-red rectangle in the breast pocket with no print. Same face. No station signs.

Portrait of the same stern woman: hair in a bun, rectangular glasses, blood-red beaded chain, holding a blank cream envelope with a plain blood-red wax disc and no stamps, doorway silhouette behind. Same face. No wall signs.

Comic panel of the same desk: three unmarked manila folders, each with only a plain blood-red wax disc, no numerals, no tabs, banker's lamp, blinds, Palace of Culture in the rain. Empty blotter. No writing.
